valuation.title: Property valuation
valuation.meta_description: A grounded market valuation for houses and apartments — confidential, free, no obligation.
valuation.headline: A valuation you can base a real decision on.
valuation.intro: A property's market value depends on far more than square metres and year built. Location, condition, fit-out, local demand and the current interest environment all interact. I look at your property in person and place it in today's market.

steps.title: Initial details
steps.body: You fill in the form below with the key facts — property type, address, size, rooms, condition. Photos are welcome but optional.

steps.title: On-site visit
steps.body: We arrange a visit at your place. I walk the property with a trained eye — not just the highlights, also the things that later trigger buyer questions.

steps.title: Market analysis
steps.body: Comparable properties, current listings nearby, actual sales. From that comes a defensible price range, not a wish figure.

steps.title: Written summary
steps.body: You receive a clear valuation as a PDF — plainly written, with the main value-driving factors made visible.

deliverables: A realistic price range — upper and lower bound with reasoning
An assessment of current demand for your specific location
Concrete pointers on what can still lift value before a sale
A no-obligation recommendation on how to proceed
valuation.form_intro: The more precise your input, the sharper the first estimate. Everything you share stays confidential.
valuation.credentials_note: Your valuation is prepared by a DEKRA-certified property valuation expert with IHK valuer qualification — not by an automated estimate alone.

selling.title: Selling
selling.meta_description: How selling your property with us works — from the first conversation through marketing to handover.
selling.headline: Eight steps to the right buyer.
selling.intro: Selling a property is rarely a snap decision. Usually a family or work change stands behind it, and then the process needs to be dependable. I walk you through it calmly and in a structured way — here is what that actually looks like.

steps.title: First conversation
steps.body: We meet or talk on the phone without pressure. You explain why the property should be sold, what your time frame is and what matters to you. No sales pitch, no forms.

steps.title: Valuation
steps.body: I see the property on site and prepare a defensible market valuation. On that basis we agree on the asking price — not too low, not unrealistic.

steps.title: Preparation & photography
steps.body: We go through what is worth doing before marketing starts. Then professional photos, floor plans and — where it fits — a short walk-through film.

steps.title: Marketing
steps.body: Targeted outreach to matching buyers from my database and, if you wish, visible marketing on portals. You decide how public it should be.

steps.title: Viewings
steps.body: I run viewings personally and in small groups — never a mass showing. Interested parties are pre-qualified so your time is not wasted.

steps.title: Negotiation
steps.body: I negotiate on your behalf with the most serious candidate. The goal is a strong price with a buyer who actually closes.

steps.title: Notary appointment
steps.body: Contract preparation with the notary, coordination of every document, presence at signing. You never have to attend an appointment alone.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: Handover minutes, meter readings, keys — cleanly documented. That closes the sale and leaves you with clear affairs.

selling.cta_body: The process begins with an honest valuation. Free, confidential, no obligation.

about.meta_description_solo: About {{agent}} — a solo real estate advisor in {{region}} with personal support from valuation to handover.
about.meta_description_team: Meet the team behind our real estate practice — personal, careful, rooted in the region.

solo.headline: I sell property the way I would want it sold to me.
paragraphs: My work begins with listening. Before I do a valuation or plan photos I want to understand why you are selling, who has lived in the property so far, and what matters to you in the process. The rest is built on those conversations.

I have deliberately chosen not to build a team. Whoever calls, gets me on the line — not a call centre, not rotating colleagues. That limits how many properties I can handle at once, but it is exactly the difference a personal sale asks for.

Professionally I stand on solid ground: IHK-certified, years of valuation practice, well connected with the notaries, trades and financing partners in the region. That helps when questions come up mid-process and need a quick answer.

team.headline: We sell property the way we would want it sold to us.
paragraphs: Our work begins with listening. Before we do a valuation or plan photos we want to understand why you are selling, who has lived in the property so far, and what matters to you in the process.
As a team we can run several processes in parallel without shortcutting attention on any single one. You have a dedicated lead — and behind them, colleagues who step in when things need to move fast.
Professionally we stand on solid ground: IHK-certified, years of valuation practice, well connected with the notaries, trades and financing partners in the region.
